coaching.headline: A one-sided win: Drongo's 15 kills and a personal kill on all five enemies anchored nine fights won, kills 31-3.
coaching.team: We won nine of ten fights and turned the 18.8 swing into Orb Prime and an Inhibitor. The 16.5 Fangtooth fight was the mistake: Feng Mao was dead and Xeebs was across map, so we started 4v5. Feng still dealt 20,283 objective damage (second on the team); one bad death doesn’t erase that pressure. Next game: if your jungler is dead before Fangtooth, trade across map or reset—don’t start the 4v5.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 18.8 teamfight, won 4-0 right after the shaky 16.5 fight where the team was down a body, turned the game for good — every fight after it went our way, including the Orb Prime and Inhibitor takes.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo lane closed the game early: first blood at 7.7, zero deaths before minute ten, and the first Fangtooth, all ours.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Drongo ran the full winning core, Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Tainted Rounds, then added Imperator and Demolisher for pure late-game execute power — on core, nothing to teach here.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vermis's on-hit max-health damage on every third basic fits Drongo's kite-and-shoot marksman combo, trading away Demiurge's item-scaling burst for the consistent DPS that carried the extended fights Drongo dominated tonight.

f07cd656-a40d-4000-a289-c7f9f8dd50f9.build: Steel skipped the entire winning core (Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard, Flux Matrix) for Crystalline Cuirass, Dynamo, Golem's Gift and Tainted Charm — the anti-heal still landed via Tainted Charm instead of Tainted Guard, and the team-high 66,420 mitigated says the swap worked fine tonight.
f07cd656-a40d-4000-a289-c7f9f8dd50f9.eternal: Vesh's ability-damage DoT fits Steel's hybrid engage kit, and the zero-death, five-kills-on-Shinbi night never needed Krix's flat health scaling instead.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Adele skipped two of the winning core's three items, Dawnstar and Raiment of Renewal, for Dynamo, Frosted Lure, Inquisition and Fire Blossom instead — nothing in tonight's zero-death, first-blood game shows the swap cost anything.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: The engine doesn't model support Eternals for Adele — Exarch, Aion, Lotus, Marrow, Nihil, Weald, Pilow and Satariel are all unmodeled, so there's no graded fit read here.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Renna ran the full winning core, Entropy, Wraith Leggings and Overseer, then added Oblivion Crown for more magical power on top — on core, nothing to teach here.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vesh's ability-damage DoT fits Renna's zone-and-chunk mage kit, rewarding the ability spam that put up 28,833 damage to heroes tonight over Demiurge's item-scaling burst.

2dc38586-23d0-4b5a-8e3c-0c4bdf03e1cc.build: Feng Mao skipped two of the winning core's three items, Painweaver and Omen, for Vyzar Carapace, Nightfall and Transference — a sustain trade that still didn't stop the solo catch by Mourn at 16 that cost the Fangtooth.
2dc38586-23d0-4b5a-8e3c-0c4bdf03e1cc.eternal: Vermis's on-hit max-health damage fits Feng Mao's basic-attack duelist combo, trading Demiurge's item-scaling burst for the sustained pressure his execute kit wants in extended trades.

focus.title: Don’t split the 4v5 from the cross-map trade.
focus.evidence: At 16.5 Feng Mao was dead before the Fangtooth fight. We still took Mini Prime while they secured Fangtooth, so the team split its pressure between a losing contest and the trade.
focus.action: When one side is already trading, call the give-and-take before the fight: yield Fangtooth and commit to Mini Prime, or reset for a later contest. Don’t split the team.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion
